game.name: ReNFS5: Open Unleashed
game.desc: Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed on the open-source Open-Unleashed engine by Second-Boot (github.com/Second-Boot/Open-Unleashed) with a native OpenGL ES 3 renderer (about 60 FPS on H700). Supply your own game files as a folder, ZIP or CD image; the native launcher imports and verifies them. Graphics, audio and input through SDL2 and gptokeyb2.
game.developer: ReNFS5 port by rzrbld; Open-Unleashed engine by Second-Boot (original game: EA Canada / EA Seattle)
